paper_title: Searches for electron interactions induced by new physics in the EDELWEISS-III germanium bolometers
notes: Paper constrains axion-electron coupling g_ae via solar axion CBRD search (g_ae < 1.1e-11 in massless limit) and ALP dark matter absorption over 0.8-500 keV mass range (Fig. 5 left). Also reports g_ae x g_aN^eff < 3.5e-17, hidden photon kinetic mixing kappa (DarkPhoton), and electron lifetime limit. Primary coupling per hint is AxionElectron. Local DM density rho_DM = 0.3 GeV/cm^3 assumed for halo absorption search, <v> ~ 1e-3 c. No numerical tables of (mass, g_ae) data points are provided; values are only shown in plots (Figs. 3-5), so no reliable point extraction possible.
